Four bedrooms, three bathrooms, and 380 sqm of living space — this beachfront villa has the room a family needs to settle properly, rather than compromise. The layout gives everyone somewhere to be: space for younger children to spread out, room for teenagers to have their own corner, and enough left over for life to happen without everyone on top of each other.

The private pool is the kind of thing that shifts where a weekend actually gets spent. With direct beach access beyond that, summers have a shape to them that a family can build routines around — mornings at the water, afternoons at the pool, no complicated logistics.

Three bathrooms across four bedrooms means the morning rush has somewhere to go. At 380 sqm, there is generous storage, genuine flexibility in how rooms are used, and the breathing room that makes a large family home feel calm rather than crowded. Panoramic sea views run through the living spaces, so the setting is present in daily life, not just on arrival.

This is a home a family grows into. The space is there for the years ahead — not a property you outgrow when a second child needs their own room or a teenager needs a door to close.
